items:
Rest Ashore 6BR/5.5 bath, Private Pool, Office w/bunk, Tower room, Media room w/bunk, 2 fridges

***We provide for your convenience complimentary beach service which includes set up of one umbrella and two lounge chairs (March through Thanksgiving). We do not provide beach towels, bikes, or additional beach chairs.

** FREE Heated Pool for use during cooler months. Set to 90 degrees!

** Ask us about our other houses in this fabulous gated neighborhood:
- Vie De Mer, 5BR/5.5 bath + bonus office with bunk bed (VRBO 374278), and
- Vie De Sol, 4BR/4 bath + 2 powder (VRBO 1624292)

A beautiful home in the lovely private gated community of Water’s Edge, adjacent to Rosemary Beach. This gorgeous vacation home is on the south side (beach side) of 30a, located 50 yards from the beach stairs. This subdivision has only 34 homes, which allows for low density private beach access. A set of chairs with umbrella are provided on the beach for our guests. “Rest Ashore” is a custom desinged 5-bedroom+, 5 ½ bath vacation home with over 3,100 square feet. It is a 3-level private home with office and media rooms, both of which have bunk beds. Beautiful hardwood and tile floors throughout. It is outfitted with high speed wireless internet and flat screen TVs with 'internet apps' in all bedrooms.

The main floor boasts a gourmet kitchen with granite counter tops, stainless steel appliances, double refrigerators, 5 burner gas cook top and a Dacor double oven with warming drawer. The open floor plan makes entertaining easy with a dining room table for eight, a bar area that seats five, and a games table that seats six. Relax in front of the 55-inch flat-screen TV. A powder room is located just off the foyer.

Stroll out back to the porch and patio area and enjoy the largest private pool in the subdivision that has a state-of-the-art (saline) non chlorinated cleaning system. Bask in the Florida sun poolside, or take a short 50-yard stroll down a lovely landscaped, palm tree lined path to the beach stairs to enjoy the beautiful white sandy beach.

This home has 3 master suites. The first floor master is a large bedroom with a king bed and a private bathroom, outfitted with granite and travertine. Strategically located away from the family room, this suite provides both privacy and convenience. Its location on the main floor makes it especially nice for anyone with reduced mobility concerns.

The main master bedroom on the second floor is unbelievable! This large bedroom with king bed has a private porch that overlooks the pool, an expansive bathroom with granite countertops, double vanities, soaking tub, and dual showerheads (w/rain-head). Attached to this bedroom is a private office/or kids room, that has a twin bunk bed. The office/bunk room closes with a French door for privacy and quiet. This office is multi-functional, as it can be used as room for kids, a quiet reading space, work area, or nursery/young child’s sleeping area. A Pack-n-Play is also available for your use (please bring your own fitted sheet for that). The other second floor master has a king bed, and is also spacious and has a private deck with gulf view. The bathroom has granite, soaking tub, and dual shower heads. For the younger crowd, we have a fantastic room on this floor that has two bunk beds, each with twin over full sized bed, that will accommodate six people. It has its own private bathroom. A full-sized dedicated laundry room with extra large capacity front loading washer/dryer is on this level. It has ample storage space, with plenty of room to sort and fold laundry. Iron and ironing board are stored here.

The tower rooms on the third floor are ideal for the ultimate kid retreat. The “pajama party room” has two queen size beds with a semi-private bathroom. The adjacent media room/bedroom is a kid's dream! There is a twin over double bunk bed in there, and a couch for watching the large smart tv. Both rooms have access to a large deck that provides great views of the Gulf. They share a full bathroom with Jack and Jill access.

Check In: 4pm ~ Unfortunately we can't accommodate an early check in. Please plan to arrive at 4pm at the earliest. Thank you!

Check Out: 10am

** This home can accommodate 3 cars in the driveway. We cannot guarantee additional parking close by.

*** No Smoking and No Pets… Thank you!

The gated community provides privacy and serenity for a relaxing vacation, yet is conveniently located within a 3-minute walk to Rosemary Beach restaurants, shops, and spa. There is a 17-mile walk/bike path located just outside our entrance, and a Tom Fazio golf course is just a mile away. Fishing, sailing and kayaking are also available locally. Rosemary Beach has tennis courts and a fitness center that can be accessed for a fee. The Publix food store is only about a 5-minute car ride east on 98. The new outdoor shopping area in Panama City, called Pier Park, is a 10-minute drive east on 98. Pier Park has numerous restaurants and stores, and a new state-of-the-art movie cinema. Seaside is 7 miles west, and the Sandestin Outlet Mall, Silver Sands, is about 20 miles west.

We custom designed, professionally decorated, and carefully outfitted this home with comfort and quality in mind, and immersed ourselves in the details to ensure it would delight both the young and the wise! Come be our guest! “Rest Ashore” - the perfect place to create priceless memories with family and friends!

reviews.text: My family spent a week enjoying Rest Ashore over the New Years Holiday. It was 5 adults and 4 children ages 4-11. The booking process was easy and Jane answered all of our questions promptly. The house was clean and the kitchen well equipped. We really appreciated the dual refrigerators in the kitchen. The highlights for us were the heated pool, proximity to the beach and the walkability to restaurants and shopping. The house was spacious for everyone with plenty of space for dining and sleeping. There is a third floor we didn't even use that would've accommodated an additional 4-6 people. We used the extra dining table for puzzle building. It was a relaxing week. We would definitely recommend this home and these owners when considering renting in the area.
